gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anek-kannada: Bent-paperclip tubes meet a squared-off woodblock height. Tilt Neon is best at bending one constant-width stroke into a splayed, loud shape, while Anek Kannada does its best work keeping terminals far from the stem.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anek-latin: Commanding in feel, Tilt Neon bends one tube-like stroke into a splayed c terminal and a large x-height with short ascenders. Anek Latin, with lowercase nearly capital height, keeps things open beside it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam reads clean and contemporary, with caps barely above lowercase. Its curve tips never touch, so a full page of paragraphs stays light under Tilt Neon, whose ribbon holds one width.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia reads clean, its rounds left unlatched like a hook. Tilt Neon supplies the volume with its monoweight stroke, while the body's capitals, barely above lowercase, keep the text quiet.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anek-tamil: Modern and contemporary, Anek Tamil rolls out big round lowercase bowls. Giving Tilt Neon the larger size lets its stencil-cut channel of constant weight lead, with Anek Tamil's half-unwrapped curves at text size.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads in wide, tall bowls, with rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook, clean and approachable. Tilt Neon adds a loud, unvarying line above all that openness.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anuphan: Clean curves with clear gaps carry the body, under a heading whose strokes hold the steadiness of a drawn string. Anuphan does best at big, round lowercase bowls; Tilt Neon does best at splayed, loud display shapes.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-arimo: Arimo brings a tall mean line and spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs, a tidy foil for the heading. And Tilt Neon, flat in line weight throughout, feels loud and tubular beside it.
